result.rationale: The diff shows loading.html.erb containing setTimeout(document.location.reload(), 30000) unconditionally, with no retry counter or failure state. If the RetrieveTopic job never produces a TopicEmbed (e.g., invalid URL throttled, feed polling disabled, user blank), the embed/best endpoint keeps rendering 'loading' and the client reloads forever. This is a real, verifiable robustness defect introduced by the diff, though minor.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`, the script unconditionally calls `document.location.reload()` after 30 seconds with no max attempts or error/failure UI. Given `EmbedController#best` renders `loading` whenever `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` is nil (and only enqueues retrieval), an embed URL that never successfully imports will keep the iframe/page reloading indefinitely.
